newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Grafton buys Dublin hotel for 5.8 mln punts.
newsitem.headline: Grafton buys Dublin hotel for 5.8 mln punts.

text.p: Irish property company Grafton Group Plc said on Monday that it had acquired an investment property in Dublin for 5.8 million Irish pounds.
Grafton said in a statement that the property, a hotel trading as the Rathmines Plaza hotel, was sold by O'Dwyer Real Estate Company Ltd on a sale and leaseback arrangement.

"The property is being acquired for asset value which is equal to the original cost of the site and the actual construction cost of the hotel property," Grafton said. It said the hotel was subject to a 35-year lease to O'Dwyers, who will continue to operate it. Grafton said a rental agreement provides for an annual rent of 0.53 million Irish pounds over four years and is subject to rent reviews thereafter. The agreement also includes a put option entitling Grafton to sell the property back to O'Dwyer Real Estate, Grafton said. -- Dublin newsroom +353 1 660 33 77
